n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())
atcoder = __import__('atcoder')
mint = atcoder.modint
mint.set_mod(mod)

# Compute binomial coefficients
C = [[mint(0) for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]
C[0][0] = mint(1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    C[i][0] = mint(1)
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]

# Precompute g
g = [mint(i * (i + 1) // 2) for i in range(n + 1)]

# Define a pair class
class Pair:
    def __init__(self, first=mint(0), second=mint(0)):
        self.first = first
        self.second = second

f = [Pair() for _ in range(n + 1)]
f[0] = Pair(mint(1), mint(0))

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        z = f[j].first * f[i - 1 - j].first * C[i - 1][j]
        f[i].first += z * mint(i + 1)
        f[i].second += z * (g[j] + g[i - 1 - j])
        f[i].second += (f[i - 1 - j].first * f[j].second + f[j].first * f[i - 1 - j].second) * C[i - 1][j] * mint(i + 1)

# Debug output (optional)
# for i in range(n + 1):
#     print(i, f[i].first.val(), f[i].second.val(), g[i].val())

# Initialize DP array
dp = [[Pair() for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(n + 2)]
dp[0][0] = Pair(mint(1), mint(0))

for l in range(n + 1):
    for r in range(l + 1, n + 2):
        di = r - l - 1
        for i in range(m - di + 1):
            z = dp[l][i].first * f[di].first
            dp[r][i + di].first += z * C[i + di][di]
            dp[r][i + di].second += (dp[l][i].second * f[di].first + dp[l][i].first * f[di].second) * C[i + di][di]

# Output the answer
print(dp[n + 1][m].second.val())
